text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm going to push the kernel+quant bundle to staging at 19:00 PT. Bundle contains kernel v3.8.2, quant-profile v4, and the kv-cache alignment patch. Anyone blocking?

mira: Not blocking, but can infra pin the staging image tag so smoke runs are stable?

sam: +1 pin. Also asking deploy-bot to run preflight checks and run a 5% canary first. Add a holdback label so we can kill traffic quickly.

alex: Plan: schedule at 19:00, canary->5% for 10m, evaluate smoke + perf dashboards, then 25% for 20m, then ramp if green. Rollback window: 19:40–20:10 final decision.

deploy-bot: preflight started for image redwood/runtime:staging-2026-03-21-kvfix (job id: 7421). Running: lint, container-scan, kernel-compat-check, quant-selftest. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/7421

jordan: Watch list: KV cache hitrate, p99 generation latency, OOM counts, and ephemeral GPU memory fragmentation. I put a short smoke script in the repo: `scripts/smoke_staging.sh` (timeout 6m).

mira: Release notes draft: "kv cache alignment fix — reduces prefix mismatch; quant kernel ABI bump — improves perf for longer seqs; new quant-profile v4 adds fallback path for small-batch workloads." I'll add that to the release notes doc and ping docs for a short blurb.

sam: Acceptance criteria before 25%: 1) no >3% error-rate delta vs baseline, 2) p95 latency < baseline+120ms, 3) no OOMs on any staging hosts for 15m. If any trigger hits, we pin to kernel v3.8.1 + quant-profile v3 and roll back across staging.

alex: Ack. If deploy-bot preflight fails, do not cut. If preflight passes but canary has noisy telemetry, we will pause and run a focused diag. Jordan — if you see kv hitrate drop >10% surface it asap.

deploy-bot: preflight finished — kernel-compat-check: OK, quant-selftest: WARNING (minor numeric diffs on fp16 path). Full log: https://ci.internal/reports/7421#quant-selftest

jordan: Those fp16 diffs look expected from the new quant path but we should confirm no regression in token-level perplexity on our evalset. I'll run `python eval/compare_fp16.py --baseline v3.8.1 --candidate v3.8.2` now.

mira: Also confirm the rollout note includes rollback steps and exact pin commands so support can action quickly. E.g.: `infra tag pin runtime=redwood/runtime:v3.8.1-20260320` and `deploy-bot rollback --image redwood/runtime:v3.8.1-20260320`.

sam: I'll prepare the emergency rollback snippet in the release doc and attach it to the staging thread.

alex: Ok starting canary at 19:00 -> 5%. Will post updates here.

[~20 minutes later]

alex: Canary 5% finished. Smoke passed. Metrics: error-rate delta 0.6%, p95 +40ms, no OOMs. Moving to 25% for 20m.

jordan: Running the eval script now — preliminary: token perplexity delta +0.3% on small-batch eval, within tolerance. FP16 diffs look cosmetic.

mira: Release notes link: https://docs.internal/releases/engine/2026-03-21-kvfix-draft (please add reviewers).

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% complete. Monitoring hooks active.

sam: If anything weird, we execute rollback plan below. Otherwise aim to finish ramp at 21:00 and schedule release notes publish for 21:15.

alex: Thanks team — keep eyes on dashboards. If we need to abort, call the `runtime-roll` pager and use the pin command above. :thumbsup:
